blinding_guess.why: All five elements are consumed only, inside cob3-9/urdf/cob3-9.urdf.xacro, and the consumer side is internally consistent (schunk_description is an exec_depend; arm joints arm_1_joint..arm_7_joint and pg70_finger_*_joint in the cob3-9 YAML match the macro names 'arm' and 'pg70'; pg70 is attached to arm_7_link). Whether it is correct depends on schunk_description at indigo: whether lwa4d.urdf.xacro and pg70.urdf.xacro exist at those paths, whether macro schunk_lwa4d accepts the has_podest parameter and emits ${name}_7_link, and whether schunk_pg70 accepts name/parent/origin. Those are non-definition files in the dependency repository, which this stage may not read.

notes: ROS 1 (indigo) package; all five packet elements are consumed xacro APIs of schunk_description, so declares and not_declared are empty and all five go into references. The only uses of lwa4d.urdf.xacro, pg70.urdf.xacro, xacro:schunk_lwa4d and xacro:schunk_pg70 in the whole snapshot are in cob_hardware_config/cob3-9/urdf/cob3-9.urdf.xacro (lines 26, 29, 61-63, 81-83). materials.urdf.xacro is also included at line 8 of cob3-6, cob4-1, cob3-2, cob4-2 and cob4-5 urdf.xacro files; provenance cites cob3-9. Macro invocations as written: schunk_lwa4d name="arm" parent="base_link" has_podest="false" with <origin xyz="${arm_x} ${arm_y} ${arm_z}" rpy="${arm_roll} ${arm_pitch} ${arm_yaw}" />; schunk_pg70 name="pg70" parent="arm_7_link" with <origin xyz="${pg70_x} ${pg70_y} ${pg70_z}" rpy="${pg70_roll} ${pg70_pitch} ${pg70_yaw}" />, offsets from cob3-9/urdf/properties.urdf.xacro (def_* from calibration_default.urdf.xacro plus offset_* from cob_calibration_data, which is not in the snapshot). Port frame for the two macros is the parent link hard-coded in the invocation; frame for the three file-include elements is null (an include has no frame of its own). msg_type, units, QoS (ROS 1), rates and definition_id are null for all ports because these are URDF/xacro API elements, not message definitions. The URDF is loaded by common/upload_robot.launch via $(find xacro)/xacro.py and tested by test/urdf_cob3-9.test (cob_description test_urdf.py). Other schunk_description APIs referenced elsewhere in the package (lwa/lwa.urdf.xacro, sdh/sdh.urdf.xacro, lwa4p_extended/lwa4p_extended.urdf.xacro and macros schunk_lwa, schunk_sdh, schunk_lwa4p_extended) are outside the packet and not listed in references. exclusive is scoped to the packet elements: the URDF macros/includes claim no exclusive resource; the package has unrelated device handles in driver configs (for example DevicePath = "/dev/pcan32" in cob3-9/config/head_driver.ini), not recorded here.
